title: 记忆形成机制
text: 在实验室里，神经科学家们正致力于解析人类大脑存储信息的复杂过程。记忆的产生并非单一事件，而是一系列生化反应与电信号传递的综合结果。首先，感觉输入通过突触传递，触发短时记忆的建立。此时，海马体发挥着至关重要的中继作用，将瞬时信号转化为相对稳定的痕迹。随后，通过长时程增强效应，神经元之间的连接强度得以提升。这种突触可塑性是认知功能实现持久化的生理基础。蛋白质合成在这一阶段起到了决定性作用，确保了结构性改变的完成。与此同时，睡眠期间的大脑会进行记忆巩固，将不稳定信息迁移至皮层。该机制有效地优化了空间布局，提高了检索效率。不同类型的记忆在脑内分布迥异，语义记忆与程序性记忆依赖于截然不同的回路。前者侧重于事实陈述，而后者则涉及运动技能的自动化。外部刺激的强度直接影响编码深度，从而决定遗忘速度。如果缺乏有效的复述，大部分信息会在极短时间内消散。情绪状态亦能通过杏仁核调节存储质量，使具有冲击力的经历被深刻烙印。这种生物学特性在进化过程中具有生存意义，帮助个体规避潜在危险。现代成像技术揭示了这些动态变化，使我们能实时观测电活动。尽管如此，意识如何将物理信号转化为主观体验仍是未解之谜。研究人员尝试利用光遗传学手段精准操纵特定神经元，以验证因果关系。这种前沿探索为治疗认知障碍提供了理论支撑。通过干预突触传递，或许能有效缓解阿尔茨海默症带来的损害。整体而言，记忆是生物体与环境交互的产物。它不仅记录过去，更塑造了主体的自我认同。深刻理解该机制将揭示人类智能的本质。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what role does the hippocampus play in memory formation?
options: It acts as a relay, converting brief signals into relatively stable memory traces
It permanently stores all long-term memories
It has no role in memory and only regulates emotion
It only processes procedural (motor-skill) memory

questions.prompt: What happens during sleep, according to the text?
options: The brain consolidates memories, transferring unstable information to the cortex
The brain stops all activity related to memory
Sleep erases short-term memories entirely
Sleep has no effect on memory processes

questions.prompt: How do semantic memory and procedural memory differ, according to the text?
options: They rely on different neural circuits — one focuses on factual statements, the other on automated motor skills
They are stored in exactly the same brain circuit
Semantic memory is only for languages, procedural memory only for sports
The text states procedural memory always fades faster than semantic memory

questions.prompt: What does the text say happens to information without effective repetition (复述)?
options: Most of it dissipates within a very short time
It is automatically transferred to permanent long-term storage
It becomes stronger through emotional reinforcement
It is only lost during sleep

questions.prompt: What technique does the text say researchers use to precisely manipulate specific neurons and verify causal relationships?
options: Optogenetics
Functional MRI
CRISPR gene editing
Electroconvulsive therapy

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
